items.title: Chevron (CVX) Brings In A 25% Partner For Its Namibia Exploration Block
items.summary: Chevron (NYSE:CVX) agreed to farm out a 25% interest in its offshore Namibia PEL 82 license to QatarEnergy. The transaction brings QatarEnergy into the Walvis Basin block, where Chevron has been advancing its exploration program. QatarEnergy's entry introduces a new state backed partner alongside Chevron in Namibia's emerging offshore sector.
